lines.name: Hayley Johnson
lines.speech: Hello, you. Sorry about earlier, I was elbow-deep in a spreadsheet. Right, did you watch the new episode yet? I haven't, I've been saving it for us.
lines.action: Sits down at the kitchen table, pushes laptop aside.

lines.name: Marnie
lines.speech: Hayley! No worries! Ooh, you saved it for us, I love you! I haven't watched it either, I promise! Right, give me two secs to grab a cuppa and then we press play together! Ready? Don't spoil anything if you've peeked at the group chat!
lines.action: Settles onto the sofa with the phone propped up, grinning.

lines.name: Marnie
lines.speech: Got my tea! Okay okay, I'm ready! Press play on three! One, two, three... go! Oh, I'm so excited, I've missed this!
lines.action: Sips tea and presses play on the episode, tucking feet under on the sofa.

lines.name: Hayley Johnson
lines.speech: Three, two... go. Right, I've got mine going too. Oh, I do like the opening music, it's very dramatic for a sponge.
lines.action: Presses play on the laptop and pulls her mug closer.

lines.name: Hayley Johnson
lines.action: Watches the episode, sipping tea, laptop propped against the fruit bowl.

lines.name: Marnie
lines.speech: Ha! Very dramatic for a sponge, yes! I love it! Ooh, look at that tent! Is it the same one as last year? Don't answer, just watch!
lines.action: Sips tea, eyes on the screen, grinning.

lines.name: Marnie
lines.speech: Ooh, look at her face when they open the oven! Oh no, that's going to sink, isn't it?! I can feel it! Hayley, are you watching this?!
lines.action: Leans toward the screen, clutching the mug with both hands.

lines.name: Hayley Johnson
lines.speech: I'm watching, I'm watching. Oh, that's sunk. That's properly sunk. Not ideal, that.
lines.action: Leans forward, wincing at the laptop screen, mug halfway to her mouth.

lines.name: Marnie
lines.speech: Noooo! Told you! Oh, that poor sponge! It's completely collapsed in the middle! Is she going to try and cover it with cream? Please say she does the cream thing!
lines.action: Winces, hands over her mouth, peeking through her fingers at the screen.

lines.name: Hayley Johnson
lines.speech: Oh, she's going for the cream. She's absolutely going for the cream. Brave, that. It's not going to hide a crater that size, though.
lines.action: Winces, then takes a sip of tea without looking away from the laptop.

lines.name: Marnie
lines.speech: Oh, that crater! She's piling it on, bless her! It's like a cream volcano! Ha! Judges are going to take one look and just sigh, I can feel it! Keep watching, keep watching!
lines.action: Winces, laughing, and shuffles forward on the sofa with the mug held tight.

lines.name: Hayley Johnson
lines.speech: Oh, the judges are doing the sigh. Right on cue. I'd have just served it in a bowl and called it a trifle, honestly.
lines.action: Snorts into her mug, eyes still on the laptop.
